name: 6.0.1-FINAL WTSA GAME RELEASE
author: Red-Winter-Studios
description:
Controls:
Up= shoot
W/S= Change Pitch
A/D= Change Yaw
Left/Right= Change roll
Instructions: Press the blue play button. It will take a moment to connect to the server, and after that you will spawn int. In the bottom right is your health. Fly around the arena and shoot down enemy players, but don't leave the arena or loose your health because you will die! If you die, click the black respawn button to load back in.

CREDITS:
Trees are made by Pixel games. they can be found at: https://assetstore.unity.com/packages/3d/vegetation/trees/realistic-tree-9-rainbow-tree-54622
Textures come from Nobiax / Yughues. they can be found at: https://assetstore.unity.com/packages/2d/textures-materials/floors/yughues-free-ground-materials-13001
server is hosted by photon PUN.
